title: Annotatio I §.IV (2): Reformed doctors — Est as significat (Zwingli) or Est signum (Oecolampadius)
pass_a_gloss: (2.) The REFORMED DOCTORS to a man, who interpret the Est in Christ’s proposition This is my body either with Zwingli by significat, or with Oecolampadius by Est the sign or figure of my body.
pass_b_english: (2.) The Reformed doctors as one interpret the Est in This is my body either with Zwingli as significat, or with Oecolampadius as Est the sign or figure of my body.
source_text: (2.) REFORMATI DOCTORES ad unum omnes, qui τὸ Est, in propositione Christi, Hoc est corpus meum, vel cum Zwinglio, per τὸ significat, vel cum Oecolampadio, per τὸ Est signum seu figura corporis mei, interpretantur.
